title: Tennis Serve Placement Error Map
dataSources: Bar-velocity reps (`vbt:rep`), sprint reps (`sprint:rep`), serve attempts (`serve:attempt`), pickleball rallies (`pickleball:rally`), swim sets (`swim:set`), archery ends (`archery:end`), balance trials (`balance:trial`), and batting reps (`batting:rep`).
app: Sports and skill telemetry from VBT devices, sprint timers, serve trackers, swim logs, archery apps, balance trainers, and batting sensors streamed to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=serve:attempt
| stats count as attempts sum(eval(if(in=1,1,0))) as serves_in by zone
| eval in_pct=round(100*serves_in/attempts,1)
| sort zone
description: Counts serves and in-percentage by target zone so placement weaknesses stand out clearly.
value: Placement quality often improves faster when you map misses by zone instead of only tracking overall serve percentage.
implementation: Send serve outcomes from a practice app or court camera model with standardized service-box zones.
visualization: Court heat map of serve accuracy by zone.
grandmaExplanation: It warns which parts of the service box you hit reliably and which spots still cause trouble.
